args.summary:
Average flipper length by species (49 rows used): Adelie 193.17 mm, Chinstrap 196.92 mm, Gentoo 216.68 mm.

Problems found and fixes applied:
1. species had 7 distinct labels instead of 3: case variants "adelie", "gentoo", "chinstrap" plus the misspelling "Gentto" (rows 17, 36, 37, 46). Applied normalize_labels to merge them into Adelie/Chinstrap/Gentoo (approved). No rows were excluded for spelling.
2. flipper_length_mm had two impossible negative values (-190 in row 2, -195 in row 50), below the rules minimum of 170 mm. Excluded those two rows (approved) rather than guessing a corrected length.
3. No exact duplicate rows.

Caveats: the two excluded rows are dropped entirely, so the per-species averages are based on 49 of 51 penguins (Adelie and Chinstrap each lose one observation). Columns not used by the question (body_mass_g stored as text with thousands separators, year stored as text) were left untouched.
